hierarchy_goals: Prioritize the most consequential risks using traceable findings and numbers.
negative_space_target: sufficient for native title, semantic objects, and visible source notes
prompt_text: Create a landscape 16:9 full-slide visual reconstruction target for role risk_findings. This is visual truth only, never the final slide surface. Composition requirements: evidence-led analytical composition, prioritized causal risk field, strong hierarchy among risks, native data-callout regions, readable focal risk narrative. Treat the linked Semantic Sidecar as the sole authority for exact wording, numbers, units, data, citations, accessibility, and native/raster policy. Reserve clean native reconstruction regions for title, subtitle, labels, body, structured data, citations, footer, and page number. Prefer no rendered text beyond large generic semantic labels. No paragraphs, full citations, tiny source notes, dense table text, tiny chart labels, pseudo-language, invented numbers, quotations, logos, watermarks, screenshots, dashboard walls, or full-slide raster background. Do not render digits, numerals, numbered labels, percentages, dates, quantities, or any other numeric characters; use unlabeled geometry or alphabetic placeholders only.
